fragment_wayfarer.name: Wayfarer Fragment
fragment_wayfarer.desc: A scrap of road-worn leather and thread. Crafting: 8 make a missing Wayfarer's Resolve piece.

fragment_emberheart.name: Emberheart Fragment
fragment_emberheart.desc: A still-warm shard of volcanic plate. Crafting: 8 make a missing Emberheart Regalia piece.

fragment_stormcaller.name: Stormcaller Fragment
fragment_stormcaller.desc: A thread of storm-woven cloth that hums when touched. Crafting: 8 make a missing Stormcaller's Vestments piece.

fragment_eclipse.name: Eclipse Fragment
fragment_eclipse.desc: A sliver of veil, half gold and half violet. Crafting: 8 make a missing Eclipse of the Twin Veil piece.
